title: Iron Legion mod manifest (mod.json5)
description: Manifest at the root of every mod folder or zip. JSON5 is parsed to JSON before validation.

id.description: Mod namespace. Every ContentId defined by this mod is '<id>:<item_id>'. Never changes across versions.

name_key.description: Localisation key of the display name, resolved from this mod's locale files.

version.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Recorded in save headers.

engine_version.description: Semver range of engine versions this mod targets, e.g. '>=0.4.0 <0.6.0'. Loading outside the range warns.

dependencies.description: Mods that must be enabled and loaded before this one.

version.description: Semver range the dependency must satisfy.

load_after.description: Soft ordering: load after these mods if they are enabled. Missing ids are ignored.

load_before.description: Soft ordering: load before these mods if they are enabled. Missing ids are ignored.

content_root.description: Folder (relative, forward slashes) holding the content kind folders.

scripts_root.description: Folder holding Lua scripts; main.lua inside it is the entry point.

assets_root.description: Folder that sprite, sound, and heightmap paths resolve against.

locales.description: Language codes provided under locale/. Informational; the folder is also scanned.

namespaces.description: Extra ContentId namespaces this mod may define. Honoured only for the flagship game at game/.
